title: ADP consensus (drafter market) + ESPN auction value - opponent model + value flags ONLY
description: FantasyFootballCalculator PPR ADP joined to our projection pool by name+position, plus ESPN's draft-room auction value (ownership.auctionValueAverage, kona) joined onto the same rows. POLICY BOUNDARY: both fields are the market of fantasy drafters. They model the simulated opponents in the draft simulator and flag value-vs-market; they are NEVER blended into projections, weights, or game probabilities - see validate_data.py MARKET_PRICE_FIELDS, which pins 'adp' and 'auction_value' mechanically. Rows without a gsis_id are real draftable players we do not project - kept for the opponent board, never given fabricated points. A row with no auction_value is one ESPN does not price: the field is absent or null, NEVER 0, because $0 is a price and 'unpriced' is not.
